checks.batch_size: 5 is reasonable, not a large margin. The failed run completed AB06's 5 records, then died in record 6, so the AB06 batch is exactly the 5 that already succeeded (RSS ~216 MiB while address space hit 768 MiB, which points at virtual growth, not resident). The other batches have 4-5 records and the same 768 MiB cap; batches 0 and 1 did 11 records fine, so growth is record-dependent or allocator-related, not a simple per-record rate. A failure costs only a re-run. Suggest launching the AB06 batch first (known pattern), then comparing peaks; if any batch fails, go to 2-3 records rather than raise the cap.
